scope: Add an opt-in set of the 16 documented technology preferences to saved job searches. Keep them distinct from required skills and verified career facts, show the saved selection after reload, and preserve it through search pause/resume.

environment.frontend: local Vite production build and connected Chromium
environment.delivery: local-only; no push or hosted automation

acceptance: The user can load the documented Active Directory through NAS defaults into editable controls; every preference starts unchecked and can be selected or cleared individually.
The UI explains these selections are opt-in search preferences, not verified career facts, and their matches are advisory rather than exclusion criteria.

Saving persists the user's selected optional_skills using the existing profile-scoped search-profile API. Connected API readback confirms unselected Active Directory and SCCM are absent, required_skills and required_keywords remain empty, and scheduling remains disabled.
Saved preferences render by readable labels after reload and remain intact through pause and resume.

Selecting the saved search in Jobs sends its persisted search_profile_id. The connected acceptance observes no external browser requests, collection requests, queued worker operations, or application submissions.

checks.evidence: 95 frontend test files and 540 tests passed.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed. Advisory: generated JavaScript is 750.27 kB, over the existing 500 kB warning threshold.
One connected Chromium test passed against an isolated SQLite fixture.
13 existing optional/required search semantic tests passed; no generic matching logic was changed.

checks.command: python -m py_compile tests/browser/test_technology_skill_seed.py; git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate
checks.evidence: Python compilation, commit diff whitespace check, and lane validation passed.

not_run: PostgreSQL-specific persistence acceptance and full Python repository suite.
Hosted Actions and hosted review (disabled by local-only policy).
Live external job-source collection; the browser test blocks all external requests and does not collect jobs.
limitations: This adds saved-search preferences only. It does not claim source coverage, job availability, candidate qualification, or any career fact.
Optional matching remains the existing advisory behavior; generic matching criteria and score logic are unchanged.
safety: Every option is off until the user explicitly loads the seed and chooses to save the profile.
The scheduled search is disabled by default and no collect operation is invoked.
The browser acceptance blocks external network access and never submits an application.
input_hash_note: input_sha256 records tested feature-worktree bytes; git_blob_sha256 records canonical candidate commit blobs. Windows line-ending conversion can make the checkout byte hash differ from the committed content hash.
